about: A desktop app for testing and load testing web APIs, similar to Postman.

prs.title: Imported form data turns + into a space
prs.broken: Pasting a browser's "Copy as cURL" kept + signs in form fields, so "hello world" was sent as "hello+world".
prs.changed: Form data from imported commands now reads + as a space, while query data sent with -G stays as it was.
prs.matters: Requests copied from the browser send the same data the browser did.

prs.title: Imported commands keep the ^ sign in their data
prs.broken: Importing a command copied from a Linux or Mac terminal removed or changed every ^ sign, even inside quoted data, which could break the request body.
prs.changed: The Windows-only handling of ^ is now skipped for commands quoted in the Linux and Mac style.
prs.matters: Requests with patterns or other text containing ^ send exactly what was copied.

prs.title: Imported API specs fill in path values like IDs
prs.broken: Importing an OpenAPI or Swagger file left placeholders like the pet ID in the address as is. Those requests went out with the placeholder and failed with a not found error.
prs.changed: I made the import turn those placeholders into path variables, with the example value from the spec filled in.
prs.matters: Imported APIs work on the first try, including every request that takes an ID.
